algorithm: BIP39 (seed) + HKDF-SHA256 (RFC 5869, derivation) + Ed25519 (RFC 8032, signatures) + X25519 (RFC 7748, ECDH)
notes: All derived keys are 32 bytes and used directly as Ed25519 seeds (RFC 8032).
Base64URL is unpadded (RFC 4648 §5); ids are base64url of the 32-byte public key.
Attestation tokens are byte-deterministic given (grant, ttlSeconds, jti, now).
Session tokens: iat/exp come from the issuer clock at creation time; vectors pin the payload bytes and reproduce the signature via Ed25519 over those bytes.

Group derive_resource_key (rc.9): Handle.deriveResourceKey — HKDF-SHA256(handlePriv, salt="me2em/resource/{resourceType}/{resourceId}", info="me2em/resource/v1[/e{epoch}][/r{revision}]", L=32). Components are canonicalized NFKC → lowercase → trim and charset-validated; revision 0 is the valid locked state (unlike derivePassword/deriveChannelKey, where revision must be ≥ 1). Vector 6 (raw type 'Ｃhat-Msg ') must equal vector 1 after canonicalization.

Group pact (rc.3, F-rc3-5): pinned-ep accept/reject (D13) and chain-liveness (strict act.iat < exp) vectors; the pact section is a golden snapshot of @me2em/pact 1.0.0-rc.3, re-verified by packages/pact/test/vectors.spec.ts.

derive_password.description: Default length 16: HKDF-SHA256(ikm=handlePriv, salt="me2em/secret/github", info="me2em/secret/v1", L=16) → base64url
Context canonicalization: NFKC + lowercase + trim → identical to "github"
NFKC: fullwidth ＧitHub (U+FF27) canonicalizes to "github" — identical secret
Revision 2: HKDF-SHA256(ikm=handlePriv, salt="me2em/secret/github", info="me2em/secret/v1/r2", L=16) — independent of revision 1

derive_channel_key.description: Channel key: HKDF-SHA256(ikm=handlePriv, salt="me2em/channel/telemetry-v1", info="me2em/channel/v1", L=32)
Channel key revision 2: info="me2em/channel/v1/r2" — independent of revision 1

derive_shared_secret.description: X25519 (Ed25519→Montgomery) + HKDF-SHA256(ikm=rawECDH, salt=sorted(64B both public keys), info="me2em/p2p-channel/v2", L=32)

attestation_handle.description: Root→Handle attestation; byte-deterministic given (grant, ttlSeconds, jti, now)

attestation_subhandle.description: Handle→SubHandle attestation signed by the Handle key (chain level 2)

attestation_wallet.description: v1 optional extensions (§5.1): wallet fields in canonical order; address is an illustrative valid-format address (base58 of the subject Handle's public key), not a wallet derived from subjectWalletPath — real path→address derivation is pinned by @me2em/solana tests (Phantom cross-check)

session_handle.description: Handle session token; payload pinned (Session.create stamps iat from the wall clock). Ed25519 over the exact payload bytes

session_subhandle.description: SubHandle session token; hPath appended after base fields (normative key order)

derive_resource_key.description: Resource key, unlocked static state: salt="me2em/resource/chat-msg/e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855", info="me2em/resource/v1" (epoch=1 omitted, revision=1 omitted)
Resource key, locked state revision=0: info="me2em/resource/v1/r0" — independent of revision 1 (blur/stub key)
Resource key, incremental subscription revision=2: info="me2em/resource/v1/r2" — independent of revisions 0/1
Resource key, day epoch: info="me2em/resource/v1/e20261105" — temporal anchor as monotonic integer
Resource key, epoch+lock combo: info="me2em/resource/v1/e20261105/r0" — epoch precedes revision in the info path
Canonicalization: raw inputs "Ｃhat-Msg " (U+FF2C fullwidth C, uppercase M, trailing space) and "e3b0…" → NFKC→lowercase→trim → same key as vector #1
Domain separation: same resource_id, different resource_type ("file") → different key
Domain separation: same resource_type, different resource_id ("msg-105") → different key

jcs.algorithm: JCS (RFC 8785 §3.2): UTF-16 code-unit property sorting + ECMAScript Number::toString + JSON string escaping + UTF-8
notes: Transcribed byte-exact from the RFC text: §3.2.2 input sample, §3.2.3 canonical output, §3.2.4 canonical UTF-8 bytes, Appendix B Table 1.

I-JSON (RFC 7493) number-range constraints apply at the JSON-text parsing boundary (RFC 8785 §3.3); serialization accepts any finite double — Appendix B pins 1e+30, 2^53 and ~2^68 beyond the safe range.

NaN / ±Infinity and every other input outside the JSON domain (BigInt, undefined, functions, symbols, lone surrogates, sparse arrays, non-plain objects, cycles) terminate with CanonicalizationError (MALFORMED @ JCS).
Executed by packages/core/test/jcs.spec.ts (471-test core suite, Node 24, 2026-11-22); the section is a shared fixture for @me2em/pact M1.2 (specs/tz-pact.md §6).

pact.algorithm: Ed25519 (RFC 8032) + JCS (RFC 8785) + SHA-256 + HKDF-SHA256 (pact key derivation, D2)
notes: Anchor seeds, PID and CH are the fixed testing fixtures (src/testing/fixtures.ts): root key = bytes(32, seed), pact key = derivePactKey(anchorKey, PID, CH, gen).
Envelope/replay/export vectors are byte-exact; Attestation chains in the liveness vectors are byte-deterministic given (grant, jti, now, ttlSeconds) and are rebuilt by the golden test, not stored.
rc.3 (F-rc3-5): pinned-ep accept/reject vectors (D13) and chain-liveness vectors (expired / future / exp = act.iat — the strict `< exp` bound) added alongside the M1.7 groups.
